```mcstas
# McStas instrument file for TOF imaging beamline

# Define parameters
lam = 3.5
dlam = 1.3
ap_D = 0.016

# Define the instrument
instrument tof_imaging_beamline

# Source component
component src
  type Source_simple
  parameters
    yheight = 0.12
    xwidth = 0.1
    dist = 1.0
    focus_xw = ap_D
    focus_yh = ap_D
    lambda0 = lam
    dlambda = dlam
    flux = 1e13
  end parameters
  position
    x = 0.0
    y = 0.0
    z = 0.0
  end position
end component

# Aperture component
component aperture
  type Slit
  parameters
    radius = 0.5 * ap_D
  end parameters
  position
    x = 0.0
    y = 0.0
    z = 1.0
  end position
  relative_to src
end component

# Scraper component
component scraper
  type Slit
  parameters
    xwidth = 0.3
    yheight = 0.3
  end parameters
  position
    x = 0.0
    y = 0.0
    z = 10.0
  end position
  relative_to src
end component

# Field of view monitor
component fov_mon
  type PSD_monitor
  parameters
    nx = 128
    ny = 128
    filename = "fov.dat"
    xwidth = 0.28
    yheight = 0.28
    restore_neutron = 1
  end parameters
  position
    x = 0.0
    y = 0.0
    z = 20.0
  end position
  relative_to src
end component

# Detector component
component det
  type PSD_monitor
  parameters
    nx = 256
    ny = 256
    filename = "det.dat"
    xwidth = 0.2
    yheight = 0.2
    restore_neutron = 1
  end parameters
  position
    x = 0.0
    y = 0.0
    z = 25.0
  end position
  relative_to src
end component

# Wavelength monitor
component det_lam
  type L_monitor
  parameters
    nL = 200
    filename = "det_lam.dat"
    xwidth = 0.2
    yheight = 0.2
    Lmin = lam - 2 * dlam
    Lmax = lam + 2 * dlam
    restore_neutron = 1
  end parameters
  position
    x = 0.0
    y = 0.0
    z = 25.01
  end position
  relative_to src
end component

# Link components in the beamline
src -> aperture -> scraper -> fov_mon -> det -> det_lam

# Run the simulation
run
  ncount = 1e6
  seed = 12345
end run

# Output the integrated intensity on every monitor
print "Integrated intensity on fov_mon: I = %f ± %f (events = %d)" using get_results(fov_mon).I, get_results(fov_mon).err, get_results(fov_mon).events
print "Integrated intensity on det: I = %f ± %f (events = %d)" using get_results(det).I, get_results(det).err, get_results(det).events
print "Integrated intensity on det_lam: I = %f ± %f (events = %d)" using get_results(det_lam).I, get_results(det_lam).err, get_results(det_lam).events
end instrument
```
